player_prompt.intro:
Nang ai Lashi {player_id} JoJoJoin ra, 5x5 hkum htai na 0-24 dai shagrin ane hkum ra.
Nang na shi ai, nang hkum htai na dai shagrin ai, e.g. '[12]'.
Nang WIN dai shi ai FOUR nang shagrin htai na dai consecutive hkum ra — four hkum htai na dai horizontally, vertically, ama diagonally.
Lashi {player_id} nang ai '{symbol}'; nang gaja ai '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Dai htawt ai lam gaw, jaw ai hkrang hte n re.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} gaw jaw ai cell n re. 0 hte 24 lapran hta rai ra na re.
invalid_move.already_occupied: Cell {cell} gaw masha ni nga sai.

game_action.placed: Lashi {player_id} dai shi ai ({symbol}) htai {cell} na.

outcome.win: Hkawn ai wa gaw {player_id} awng dang sai!
